Question: Can you "skip" a class requirement in college if you already know everything in the class?
Answer: No. But the US degree programs tend to be very flexible. It is rare that there is only one class that can fulfill a requirement. So take the alternative. Even if you can't, you should approach the class that you think you know with humility and and open mind. You probably don't know it nearly as well as you think. There's always more to learn about a subject. Always. People who think they know everything about a subject is usually very ignorant about it indeed. That or arrogant and delusional.

Question: How do I make a liquid that has an evaporation rate of zero?
Answer: Liquid is a state. You can't really make them. I think you are referring to vapor pressure. Ionic liquids have extremely low or practically non-existent vapor pressures (won't evaporate). Some of them are very simple to make if you have basic synthesis skills and access to the chemicals.
